name: window
note: one whole session in one loop, the day turning under it

name: hero
note: the fan-out at noon: busy sea, five kittens, the sand carrying the tool calls

name: worried
note: a command exited 1: the companion carries it

name: ask
note: dusk: the agent needs permission, solid balloon, alert pose

name: done
note: night: done, dotted balloon, the constellation, the moon with its readout

name: resting
note: dawn, half a minute later: flat sea, the writing receding, the litter swims off as its dwell ends

name: g-ask
note: the balloon rises and the companion turns to face you

name: g-done
note: the finish knock, and the companion holds the pose

name: g-worried
note: a command exits 1 and the companion carries it

name: g-sea
note: the sea gets up as the work does, and settles after

name: g-sand
note: each tool call is written at the waterline, and taken

name: g-moon
note: the disc wanes and sinks as the window fills

name: g-kittens
note: one kitten per subagent, and each swims off when it is done

name: g-sky
note: the sky on your own clock, a day in five seconds

name: g-stars
note: a star for every finished item, and a new list clears them
